_eligibility_text:
**Eligibility Criteria for the Student:** 1. The student should be a native of Jharkhand. 1. The student belongs to the scheduled caste category. 1. The student's family annual income should not exceed ₹2,50,000/-. 1. The student must be enrolled in a recognized educational institution that complies with the rules of the scheme and is registered on the departmental scholarship portal. 1. The student should be pursuing a post-matric course (Degree, Diploma, Certificate, or equivalent). 1. The student should not be receiving any other scholarship or financial assistance from the central or state government.
**Classification of Courses:** [Page No. 4](https://ekalyan.cgg.gov.in/downloads/Post_Matric_Scholarship_sankalp_2022.pdf) 1. Group 1: Professional degree/postgraduate courses in institutions with A++ to B++ NAAC accreditation. 1. Group 2: Vocational and diploma courses requiring Class 12 or higher qualifications. 1. Group 3: Polytechnic and other courses not covered in Groups 1 or 2. 1. Group 4: Graduate and Post Graduate course. 1. Group 5: All post-matriculation (Post Class X level non-degree courses).
